ModMetaData.name: Shallow Water Floor Tile Renew (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: rune1993 - 1.6 adapted by Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
Update of rune1993's Shallow Water Floor Tile to RimWorld 1.6.
I am not the author of this mod. The idea and the original defs are rune1993's - all I did was the work needed to make it run on 1.6, and the work needed to make it run at all. Credit goes to them; mistakes in the update are mine. If the original author comes back to it, or asks me to take this down, I will.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2217225014 (stopped at 1.3)
What it does
Shallow water you can lay down like a floor. Two terrains, both built for 2 wood from the Floors tab:
- Shallow water, which behaves like the natural kind - pawns wade through it, bridges can be built over it, nothing grows in it. - Fertile water, which crops grow in: fertility 1.25, and no movement penalty. It is not water any more as far as the colony is concerned - nothing can be bridged over it, and it will not carry a waterproof conduit. That is how the original author wrote it, and it is kept.
No code, no dependencies. Safe to add to an ongoing save. Removing it mid-save is the usual terrain-mod caveat: tear up any tile you have laid before you unsubscribe, or the save comes back with terrain it can no longer resolve.
What changed in the 1.6 update
The mod never worked, in any version. Both terrains declared terrainAffordanceNeeded as a list of Heavy and Light, but the game reads that field as a single TerrainAffordanceDef: the parser ran the two together into "HeavyLight", a surface no def declares, and neither terrain could be built. Since 2021. They now ask for Light, the permissive one of the two, which every soil and every floor provides.
Both terrains also had no work cost. WaterShallowBase declares no WorkToBuild and the stat defaults to 1, so each tile was laid instantly - fertile ground for two wood and no waiting. Shallow water is now 120 work, alongside straw matting; fertile water is 400, still far below the 700 per tile of a hydroponics basin.
Added along the way: a description on each terrain, so the build menu has something to show, and the floor draw styles that every vanilla floor gets.
The defNames are unchanged on purpose. Renaming them would drop both terrains out of any save that already uses them.
Source and changelog: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Shallow-Water-Floor
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic). Thanks to rune1993 for the mod.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
